Players Committee card-gallery image of [[Blast The Door, Kid!]] (A New Hope, black border) printing Decipher's [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] errata wording: “If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force to exclude from that battle all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides).” It is the image of [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071218114717/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/anewhope/ls/blastthedoorkid.gif blastthedoorkid.gif] in the Players Committee card gallery at swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 18 December 2007). The PC's card list pages at swccgpc.com/cards/ (2007–2008) showed one image per card; this is not a scan of a printed card.

The bronze disc at the bottom right is not on any Decipher card. In the 2007 PC gallery it appears only on images whose game text was changed to errata wording (for example Blast The Door, Kid!, [[Chewbacca]] and [[Great Shot, Kid!]]); unchanged cards such as [[Attack Run]] have none.

Edits: none. The archived bytes are uploaded unchanged (367×506; SHA-1 1356287a578d2eebb07ca228b44d8d5c0f0a7d65).
